    A monomial band from a line of the cover #

    Labels of cover paths are paths of Q_P with the same value (pathMor_labs). A minimal good pair of sinks of a line (WLine.GoodPair) projects to a closed walk of Q_P with a sink; it is locally injective and primitive, and its directed segments are directed segments of the line, so they have nonzero value. If P has no contours, this is a monomial band of k(P) (BO23, proof of Theorem 7; BO13b, Lemma 7.2).
